```{r}
introduce(data)
plot_intro(data)
plot_missing(data)

#create_report(data)
# Data issues

# The report also shows a huge mess in the naming meaning that if the factors remained then it would lead to unwanted dimensions. 
# e.g. "suv" and "Suv" being seperate categories
# I would want to reimport the data and string match first, specify the levels and string match.

VehicleTypes      <- c("Sedan", "SUV", "Hatch", "Ute", "Sports")
GaragingLocations <- c("Garage", "Street", "Carport", NA)
VehicleUses       <- c("Private", "Private_Business")

# 2. Match incoming data to the closest allowed value
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    VehicleType = as.factor(VehicleTypes[
      amatch(str_to_lower(VehicleType), str_to_lower(VehicleTypes), maxDist = 3)
    ]),
    
    GaragingLocation = as.factor(GaragingLocations[
      amatch(str_to_lower(GaragingLocation), str_to_lower(GaragingLocations), maxDist = 3)
    ]),
    
    VehicleUse = as.factor(VehicleUses[
      amatch(str_to_lower(VehicleUse), str_to_lower(VehicleUses), maxDist = 3)
    ])
  )

# create_report(data)


# When deciding to model the ExcessChosen as a factor I noticed that there was 4 unique values 500, 750, 999 and 1000
# To me 999 sounded odd as it was very close to 1000. Plotting the histogram I see that 999 represents a small part of the dataset 0.4%
# It could be a mistaken value, I found that occasionally on legacy insurance datasets 999 is a common value to represent 1000 as it fits
# within 3 digit field limit. Our dataset is now powerful enough to handle 4 digits. Reducing to 3 factors will also improve model stability.

hist(data$ExcessChosen)
sum(data$ExcessChosen == 999)

# Issues with the driver age some are NA and some are -1
unique(data$DriverAge)
sum(data$DriverAge == -1)

# Following this pattern I also found issues with:
# - Driver age (we found before) -1 and NA values -> Convert -1 into NA
# - VehicleAge (VehAge) has many impossible negative values -> Check what is going on here

for (col in names(data)) {
  cat("Column:", col, "\n")
  print(unique(data[[col]]))
  cat("-----------------\n")
}

hist(data$VehAge[data$VehAge < 0]) # seems like a small value we will first convert to NAs and assess overall missingness

# I also noticed that the driver age shows some data points at a crazy age which I don't think is possible
length(data$DriverAge[data$DriverAge > 100]) # 111 all all 150 which seems like an error
unique(data$DriverAge)

data = data %>%
  mutate(
    ExcessChosen = as.integer(if_else(ExcessChosen == 999, 1000, ExcessChosen)),
    DriverAge = if_else(DriverAge == -1, NA, DriverAge),
    VehAge = if_else(VehAge < 0, NA, VehAge)
  ) %>%
  filter(DriverAge < 120) # set max age at 120

#create_report(data)

missing = data |> filter(if_any(everything(), is.na)) # 4207 rows or 5.64% of the data is missing

# Missing values seem to not show any pattern in predicting the claim
data %>%
  mutate(is_missing = if_else(
    if_any(everything(), is.na),
    TRUE,
    FALSE
  )) %>%
  group_by(is_missing) %>%
  summarise(mean_claim = mean(ClaimAmount, na.rm = TRUE))

# Then we can remove/clean out the missing rows
data = na.omit(data)

# create_report(data)

str(data)

duplicates = get_dupes(data) # there are 688 duplicate values

data = unique(data)

# save clean dataset
write_csv(data, "cleaned_claims.csv")
```

n_distinct(claims$PolicyID)

  summarise(
    Observations = n(),
    TotalClaims = sum(ClaimNb),
    TotalClaimCost = sum(ClaimAmount),
    ClaimFrequency = mean(ClaimNb),

    AverageClaimCost = sum(ClaimAmount) / sum(ClaimNb),
    PurePremium = mean(ClaimAmount)

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Compare Poisson, Negative Binomial and ZINB models
# ============================================================

# install.packages("pscl")
library(MASS)
library(pscl)

# Keep the cleaned input free of prediction columns, including stale session values.
cleaned_claims <- cleaned_claims %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("PoissonPred", "NBPred", "ZINBPred")))

# Treat the three excess options consistently in every frequency and severity fit.
# Convert before splitting so training and validation share the same levels.
cleaned_claims <- cleaned_claims %>%
  mutate(ExcessChosen = factor(ExcessChosen, levels = c(500, 750, 1000)))
stopifnot(is.factor(cleaned_claims$ExcessChosen),
          !anyNA(cleaned_claims$ExcessChosen))
# Full-history fits below are exploratory diagnostics, not held-out validation.
names(cleaned_claims)

# Frequency model formula
freq_formula <- ClaimNb ~ DriverAge + YearsLicensed + VehAge + VehValue +
  VehicleType + RiskZone + Density + AnnualKms +
  ExcessChosen + GaragingLocation + VehicleUse +
  NCDLevel + TenureYears + MultiPolicyFlag +
  PaymentFrequency + offset(log(Exposure))

# Poisson model
poisson_model <- glm(
  freq_formula,
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data = cleaned_claims
)

# Poisson dispersion
poisson_deviance_dispersion <- deviance(poisson_model) /
  df.residual(poisson_model)

poisson_pearson_dispersion <- sum(
  residuals(poisson_model, type = "pearson")^2
) / df.residual(poisson_model)

cat("Poisson deviance dispersion:",
    poisson_deviance_dispersion, "\n")

cat("Poisson Pearson dispersion:",
    poisson_pearson_dispersion, "\n")

# Negative Binomial model
nb_model <- glm.nb(
  freq_formula,
  data = cleaned_claims
)

cat("Negative Binomial theta:",
    nb_model$theta, "\n")

# Compare AIC
AIC(poisson_model, nb_model)

# Do not compare these residual deviances with anova: the dispersion models differ.
# Use the AIC comparison and held-out validation instead.
```

```{r}
#Out of Sample Validation
# ============================================================
# OUT-OF-SAMPLE VALIDATION: 2023-2025 TRAIN, 2026 TEST
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
# Training and validation data
train <- cleaned_claims %>%
  filter(Year <= 2025)

test <- cleaned_claims %>%
  filter(Year == 2026)

# Same frequency formula
freq_formula <- ClaimNb ~ DriverAge + YearsLicensed + VehAge + VehValue +
  VehicleType + RiskZone + Density + AnnualKms +
  ExcessChosen + GaragingLocation + VehicleUse +
  NCDLevel + TenureYears + MultiPolicyFlag +
  PaymentFrequency + offset(log(Exposure))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fit Poisson on training data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

poisson_train <- glm(
  freq_formula,
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data = train
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fit Negative Binomial on training data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

nb_train <- glm.nb(
  freq_formula,
  data = train
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Predictions on 2026
# ------------------------------------------------------------

test$PoissonPred <- predict(
  poisson_train,
  newdata = test,
  type = "response"
)

test$NBPred <- predict(
  nb_train,
  newdata = test,
  type = "response"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate validation metrics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

poisson_mae <- mean(
  abs(test$ClaimNb - test$PoissonPred)
)

nb_mae <- mean(
  abs(test$ClaimNb - test$NBPred)
)

poisson_rmse <- sqrt(
  mean((test$ClaimNb - test$PoissonPred)^2)
)

nb_rmse <- sqrt(
  mean((test$ClaimNb - test$NBPred)^2)
)

```

```{r}
# Zero-inflated negative binomial
library(pscl)

# ZINB model
zinb_model <- zeroinfl(
  freq_formula,
  data = cleaned_claims,
  dist = "negbin"
)

# Model comparison
AIC(poisson_model, nb_model, zinb_model)
BIC(poisson_model, nb_model, zinb_model)

# ZINB summary
summary(zinb_model)

# Predictions belong in test, using the training-only model below.
# Do not attach full-history fitted predictions to cleaned_claims.
# ZINB trained on 2023-2025
zinb_train <- zeroinfl(
  freq_formula,
  data = train,
  dist = "negbin"
)

# Both ZINB fits produced singular-Hessian warnings in the 8 October run.
# Predictions are retained as exploratory; do not interpret their NA standard errors.
# Optimizer convergence alone does not establish a stable fit.

# Predict 2026
test$ZINBPred <- predict(
  zinb_train,
  newdata = test,
  type = "response"
)

# Validation metrics
zinb_mae <- mean(
  abs(test$ClaimNb - test$ZINBPred)
)

zinb_rmse <- sqrt(
  mean((test$ClaimNb - test$ZINBPred)^2)
)

validation_results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Poisson", "Negative Binomial", "ZINB"),
  MAE = c(poisson_mae, nb_mae, zinb_mae),
  RMSE = c(poisson_rmse, nb_rmse, zinb_rmse),
  ActualClaims = sum(test$ClaimNb),
  PredictedClaims = c(
    sum(test$PoissonPred),
    sum(test$NBPred),
    sum(test$ZINBPred)
  ),
  ActualFrequency = mean(test$ClaimNb),
  PredictedFrequency = c(
    mean(test$PoissonPred),
    mean(test$NBPred), 
    mean(test$ZINBPred)
  )
)

# All three predictions must exist on the same 2026 rows.
stopifnot(
  all(test$Year == 2026),
  all(train$Year <= 2025),
  all(vapply(test[c("PoissonPred", "NBPred", "ZINBPred")],
             function(x) all(is.finite(x)) && all(x >= 0), logical(1))),
  !any(c("PoissonPred", "NBPred", "ZINBPred") %in% names(cleaned_claims))
)
validation_results$PredictedToActual <-
  validation_results$PredictedClaims / validation_results$ActualClaims
print(validation_results)

# Observed and predicted totals use the same rows and exposure denominator.
frequency_aggregate <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Observed", "Poisson", "Negative Binomial", "ZINB"),
  TotalClaims = c(sum(test$ClaimNb), sum(test$PoissonPred),
                  sum(test$NBPred), sum(test$ZINBPred))
)
frequency_aggregate$Frequency <- frequency_aggregate$TotalClaims / sum(test$Exposure)
knitr::kable(frequency_aggregate, digits = 4,
             caption = "Actual and predicted claims for the same 2026 validation book")
```

## Severity: corrected Gamma baseline

```{r}
#| label: severity-data
severity_data <- cleaned_claims %>%
  filter(ClaimNb > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    AvgSeverity = ClaimAmount / ClaimNb,
    ExcessChosen = factor(ExcessChosen, levels = c(500, 750, 1000))
  )

stopifnot(
  all(is.finite(severity_data$AvgSeverity)),
  all(severity_data$AvgSeverity > 0),
  !anyNA(severity_data$ExcessChosen)
)

severity_train <- severity_data %>% filter(Year <= 2025)
severity_test <- severity_data %>% filter(Year == 2026)

severity_formula <- AvgSeverity ~ DriverAge + YearsLicensed + VehAge + VehValue +
  VehicleType + RiskZone + Density + AnnualKms +
  ExcessChosen + GaragingLocation + VehicleUse +
  NCDLevel + TenureYears + MultiPolicyFlag + PaymentFrequency
```

```{r}
#| label: severity-gamma-fit
gamma_model <- glm(
  severity_formula,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  weights = ClaimNb,
  data = severity_train,
  na.action = na.fail
)
stopifnot(gamma_model$converged)

gamma_pred <- predict(gamma_model, newdata = severity_test, type = "response")
stopifnot(all(is.finite(gamma_pred)), all(gamma_pred > 0))
summary(gamma_model)
```

### Validation on 2026 positive-claim policy-years

```{r}
#| label: severity-gamma-validation
# Gamma results are displayed once in the all-model comparison below.
actual <- severity_test$AvgSeverity
claim_weights <- severity_test$ClaimNb
actual_cost <- sum(severity_test$ClaimAmount)
predicted_cost_given_counts <- sum(claim_weights * gamma_pred)

severity_validation <- data.frame(
  Model = "Gamma (claim-count weighted)",
  PolicyYears = nrow(severity_test),
  Claims = sum(claim_weights),
  WeightedMAE = weighted.mean(abs(actual - gamma_pred), claim_weights),
  WeightedRMSE = sqrt(weighted.mean((actual - gamma_pred)^2, claim_weights)),
  ActualSeverity = weighted.mean(actual, claim_weights),
  PredictedSeverity = weighted.mean(gamma_pred, claim_weights),
  ActualCost = actual_cost,
  PredictedCostGivenCounts = predicted_cost_given_counts,
  PredictedToActual = predicted_cost_given_counts / actual_cost
)

# Check broad risk-group calibration as well as the portfolio total.
severity_by_zone <- severity_test %>%
  mutate(PredictedCostGivenCounts = ClaimNb * gamma_pred) %>%
  group_by(RiskZone) %>%
  summarise(
    PolicyYears = n(),
    Claims = sum(ClaimNb),
    ActualCost = sum(ClaimAmount),
    PredictedCostGivenCounts = sum(PredictedCostGivenCounts),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(PredictedToActual = PredictedCostGivenCounts / ActualCost)
```

### Corrected severity alternatives and comparison

```{r}
#| label: severity-alternatives
inverse_gaussian_corrected <- glm(
  severity_formula,
  family = inverse.gaussian(link = "log"),
  weights = ClaimNb,
  data = severity_train,
  na.action = na.fail,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 100)
)
stopifnot(inverse_gaussian_corrected$converged)

log_severity_formula <- update(severity_formula, log(AvgSeverity) ~ .)
# Intentionally unweighted: retain the team's constant log-variance candidate.
# Fitting weights need not match across model families for a fair predictive test.
# All validation metrics below use identical rows and ClaimNb evaluation weights.
# Adding ClaimNb here would change the variance assumption; sigma^2/2 could not
# simply be reused as a universal retransformation correction.
log_severity_corrected <- lm(
  log_severity_formula,
  data = severity_train,
  na.action = na.fail
)
# Estimate log-error variance from training data only.
severity_log_sigma2 <- summary(log_severity_corrected)$sigma^2

severity_predictions <- list(
  Gamma = gamma_pred,
  Lognormal = exp(predict(
    log_severity_corrected, newdata = severity_test
  ) + severity_log_sigma2 / 2),
  Inverse_Gaussian = predict(
    inverse_gaussian_corrected, newdata = severity_test, type = "response"
  )
)
stopifnot(all(vapply(severity_predictions, function(x) {
  length(x) == nrow(severity_test) && all(is.finite(x)) && all(x > 0)
}, logical(1))))
```

```{r}
#| label: severity-model-comparison
# All metrics use identical validation rows and claim-count weights.
severity_model_comparison <- bind_rows(lapply(names(severity_predictions), function(name) {
  pred <- severity_predictions[[name]]
  y <- severity_test$AvgSeverity
  w <- severity_test$ClaimNb
  data.frame(
    Model = name,
    WeightedMAE = weighted.mean(abs(y - pred), w),
    WeightedRMSE = sqrt(weighted.mean((y - pred)^2, w)),
    MeanGammaDeviance = weighted.mean(2 * (y / pred - 1 - log(y / pred)), w),
    ActualSeverity = weighted.mean(y, w),
    PredictedSeverity = weighted.mean(pred, w),
    PredictedCostGivenCounts = sum(w * pred),
    ActualCost = sum(w * y),
    PredictedToActual = sum(w * pred) / sum(w * y)
  )
})) %>% arrange(WeightedRMSE)
knitr::kable(severity_model_comparison, digits = 3,
             caption = "Corrected severity validation on 2026")

severity_comparison_by_zone <- bind_rows(lapply(names(severity_predictions), function(name) {
  severity_test %>%
    mutate(PredictedCost = ClaimNb * severity_predictions[[name]]) %>%
    group_by(RiskZone) %>%
    summarise(Claims = sum(ClaimNb), ActualCost = sum(ClaimAmount),
              PredictedCost = sum(PredictedCost), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Model = name, PredictedToActual = PredictedCost / ActualCost)
}))
print(severity_comparison_by_zone)
```

```{r}
#| label: model-development-setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(splines)

model_factor_variables <- c(
  "VehicleType", "RiskZone", "AnnualKms", "ExcessChosen",
  "GaragingLocation", "VehicleUse", "PaymentFrequency",
  "MultiPolicyFlag"
)

selection_data <- cleaned_claims %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_factor_variables), factor),
    YearIndex = Year - 2023,
    AvgSeverity = if_else(ClaimNb > 0, ClaimAmount / ClaimNb, NA_real_),
    DriverAgeBand = cut(
      DriverAge,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 24, 34, 49, 64, Inf),
      labels = c("24 or less", "25 to 34", "35 to 49", "50 to 64", "65 or more")
    ),
    YearsLicensedBand = cut(
      YearsLicensed,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 9, 19, 29, 39, Inf),
      labels = c("0 to 9", "10 to 19", "20 to 29", "30 to 39", "40 or more")
    ),
    VehAgeBand = cut(
      VehAge,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 2, 5, 10, 15, Inf),
      labels = c("0 to 2", "3 to 5", "6 to 10", "11 to 15", "16 or more")
    ),
    VehValueBand = cut(
      VehValue,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 15000, 25000, 40000, Inf),
      labels = c("Up to 15000", "15001 to 25000", "25001 to 40000", "Over 40000")
    ),
    DensityBand = cut(
      Density,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 50, 500, 2000, Inf),
      labels = c("Up to 50", "51 to 500", "501 to 2000", "Over 2000")
    ),
    TenureBand = cut(
      TenureYears,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 1, 3, 6, Inf),
      labels = c("0 to 1", "2 to 3", "4 to 6", "7 or more")
    )
  )

inner_train <- selection_data %>% filter(Year <= 2024)
inner_validation <- selection_data %>% filter(Year == 2025)

inner_severity_train <- inner_train %>% filter(ClaimNb > 0)
inner_severity_validation <- inner_validation %>% filter(ClaimNb > 0)

common_categorical_terms <- c(
  "VehicleType", "RiskZone", "AnnualKms", "ExcessChosen",
  "GaragingLocation", "VehicleUse", "MultiPolicyFlag",
  "PaymentFrequency"
)

linear_term_map <- c(
  DriverAge = "DriverAge",
  YearsLicensed = "YearsLicensed",
  VehAge = "VehAge",
  VehValue = "VehValue",
  Density = "Density",
  NCDLevel = "NCDLevel",
  TenureYears = "TenureYears",
  setNames(common_categorical_terms, common_categorical_terms)
)

spline_term_map <- c(
  DriverAge = "splines::ns(DriverAge, df = 4)",
  YearsLicensed = "splines::ns(YearsLicensed, df = 4)",
  VehAge = "splines::ns(VehAge, df = 3)",
  VehValue = "splines::ns(VehValue, df = 3)",
  Density = "splines::ns(Density, df = 3)",
  NCDLevel = "factor(NCDLevel)",
  TenureYears = "splines::ns(TenureYears, df = 3)",
  setNames(common_categorical_terms, common_categorical_terms)
)

banded_term_map <- c(
  DriverAge = "DriverAgeBand",
  YearsLicensed = "YearsLicensedBand",
  VehAge = "VehAgeBand",
  VehValue = "VehValueBand",
  Density = "DensityBand",
  NCDLevel = "factor(NCDLevel)",
  TenureYears = "TenureBand",
  setNames(common_categorical_terms, common_categorical_terms)
)

term_maps <- list(
  Linear = linear_term_map,
  Spline = spline_term_map,
  Banded = banded_term_map
)

make_candidate_formula <- function(response, form, included_features = NULL,
                                   exposure_offset = FALSE) {
  term_map <- term_maps[[form]]

  if (is.null(included_features)) {
    included_features <- names(term_map)
  }

  rhs <- c("YearIndex", unname(term_map[included_features]))

  if (exposure_offset) {
    rhs <- c(rhs, "offset(log(Exposure))")
  }

  reformulate(rhs, response = response)
}

poisson_deviance_total <- function(actual, predicted) {
  predicted <- pmax(predicted, 1e-10)
  contribution <- predicted
  positive <- actual > 0
  contribution[positive] <- actual[positive] *
    log(actual[positive] / predicted[positive]) -
    actual[positive] + predicted[positive]
  2 * sum(contribution)
}

gamma_deviance_mean <- function(actual, predicted, weights) {
  predicted <- pmax(predicted, 1e-10)
  weighted.mean(
    2 * (actual / predicted - 1 - log(actual / predicted)),
    weights
  )
}

choose_parsimonious <- function(results, metric = "ValidationDeviance",
                                tolerance = 0.005) {
  best_value <- min(results[[metric]])

  results %>%
    filter(.data[[metric]] <= best_value * (1 + tolerance)) %>%
    arrange(BIC, Parameters) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    pull(Specification)
}
```

### Frequency functional form

```{r}
#| label: frequency-form-selection

frequency_form_models <- lapply(names(term_maps), function(form) {
  glm(
    make_candidate_formula(
      response = "ClaimNb",
      form = form,
      exposure_offset = TRUE
    ),
    family = poisson(link = "log"),
    data = inner_train
  )
})
names(frequency_form_models) <- names(term_maps)

frequency_form_results <- bind_rows(lapply(names(frequency_form_models), function(form) {
  model <- frequency_form_models[[form]]
  predicted <- predict(model, newdata = inner_validation, type = "response")

  tibble(
    Specification = form,
    Parameters = attr(logLik(model), "df"),
    AIC = AIC(model),
    BIC = BIC(model),
    ValidationDeviance = poisson_deviance_total(
      inner_validation$ClaimNb,
      predicted
    ),
    MAE = mean(abs(inner_validation$ClaimNb - predicted)),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((inner_validation$ClaimNb - predicted)^2)),
    ActualToExpected = sum(inner_validation$ClaimNb) / sum(predicted)
  )
})) %>% arrange(ValidationDeviance)

selected_frequency_form <- choose_parsimonious(frequency_form_results)

knitr::kable(
  frequency_form_results,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Frequency functional-form selection using 2025"
)
selected_frequency_form
```

    Parameters = attr(logLik(model), "df"),
    AIC = AIC(model),

    WeightedMAE = weighted.mean(abs(actual - predicted), weights),
    WeightedRMSE = sqrt(weighted.mean((actual - predicted)^2, weights)),
    ActualToExpected = sum(weights * actual) / sum(weights * predicted)
  )
})) %>% arrange(ValidationDeviance)

```{r}
#| label: frequency-feature-selection

all_frequency_features <- names(term_maps[[selected_frequency_form]])
frequency_features_without_licence <- setdiff(
  all_frequency_features,
  "YearsLicensed"
)

  make_candidate_formula(
    response = "ClaimNb",

    included_features = frequency_features_without_licence,

  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data = inner_train

frequency_bic_model <- step(
  frequency_no_licence_model,
  scope = list(
    lower = frequency_lower_formula,
    upper = formula(frequency_no_licence_model)
  ),
  direction = "backward",
  k = log(nrow(inner_train)),
  trace = 0
)

frequency_feature_models <- list(
  Full = frequency_full_model,
  NoYearsLicensed = frequency_no_licence_model,
  BICReduced = frequency_bic_model
)

  model <- frequency_feature_models[[name]]

    ),

    RMSE = sqrt(mean((inner_validation$ClaimNb - predicted)^2)),
    ActualToExpected = sum(inner_validation$ClaimNb) / sum(predicted)
  )
})) %>% arrange(ValidationDeviance)

  actual <- inner_severity_validation$AvgSeverity
  weights <- inner_severity_validation$ClaimNb

  tibble(
    Specification = name,
    Parameters = attr(logLik(model), "df"),
    AIC = AIC(model),
    BIC = BIC(model),
    ValidationDeviance = gamma_deviance_mean(actual, predicted, weights),
    WeightedMAE = weighted.mean(abs(actual - predicted), weights),
    WeightedRMSE = sqrt(weighted.mean((actual - predicted)^2, weights)),
    ActualToExpected = sum(weights * actual) / sum(weights * predicted)
  )
})) %>% arrange(ValidationDeviance)

selected_severity_specification <- choose_parsimonious(
  severity_feature_results
)
selected_severity_development_model <- severity_feature_models[[
  selected_severity_specification
]]

knitr::kable(
  severity_feature_results,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Severity feature selection using 2025"
)
selected_severity_specification
attr(terms(selected_severity_development_model), "term.labels")
```

## Frequency and severity trend investigation

```{r}
#| label: annual-trend-summary

annual_experience <- selection_data %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Policies = n(),
    Exposure = sum(Exposure),
    Claims = sum(ClaimNb),
    ClaimCost = sum(ClaimAmount),
    Frequency = Claims / Exposure,
    Severity = ClaimCost / Claims,
    PurePremium = ClaimCost / Exposure,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

annual_experience

annual_experience %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, Frequency, Severity) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Frequency, Severity),
    names_to = "Measure",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Year, Value)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 2, colour = "steelblue") +
  facet_wrap(~Measure, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2023:2026) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual claim frequency and severity",
    x = "Policy year",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| label: adjusted-trend-investigation

frequency_trend_model <- glm(
  formula(selected_frequency_development_model),
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data = selection_data
)

severity_trend_model <- glm(
  formula(selected_severity_development_model),
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  weights = ClaimNb,
  data = selection_data %>% filter(ClaimNb > 0)
)

extract_annual_trend <- function(model, component) {
  coefficient_table <- coef(summary(model))
  estimate <- coefficient_table["YearIndex", "Estimate"]
  standard_error <- coefficient_table["YearIndex", "Std. Error"]

  tibble(
    Component = component,
    AnnualTrend = exp(estimate) - 1,
    Lower95 = exp(estimate - 1.96 * standard_error) - 1,
    Upper95 = exp(estimate + 1.96 * standard_error) - 1,
    PValue = coefficient_table["YearIndex", ncol(coefficient_table)]
  )
}

trend_results <- bind_rows(
  extract_annual_trend(frequency_trend_model, "Frequency"),
  extract_annual_trend(severity_trend_model, "Severity")
) %>%
  mutate(
    RecommendedAnnualTrend = if_else(PValue < 0.05, AnnualTrend, 0)
  )

frequency_year_factor_formula <- update(
  formula(selected_frequency_development_model),
  . ~ . - YearIndex + factor(Year)
)

severity_year_factor_formula <- update(
  formula(selected_severity_development_model),
  . ~ . - YearIndex + factor(Year)
)

frequency_year_factor_model <- glm(
  frequency_year_factor_formula,
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data = selection_data
)

severity_year_factor_model <- glm(
  severity_year_factor_formula,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  weights = ClaimNb,
  data = selection_data %>% filter(ClaimNb > 0)
)

year_shape_tests <- tibble(
  Component = c("Frequency", "Severity"),
  FactorYearPValue = c(
    anova(
      frequency_trend_model,
      frequency_year_factor_model,
      test = "Chisq"
    )$`Pr(>Chi)`[2],
    anova(
      severity_trend_model,
      severity_year_factor_model,
      test = "F"
    )$`Pr(>F)`[2]
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  trend_results,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Risk-adjusted annual frequency and severity trends"
)

knitr::kable(
  year_shape_tests,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Test of linear trend against factor Year"
)
```

## Selected specification validation on 2026

```{r}
#| label: selected-model-validation-2026

outer_train <- selection_data %>% filter(Year <= 2025)
outer_validation <- selection_data %>% filter(Year == 2026)

selected_frequency_model_2023_2025 <- glm(
  formula(selected_frequency_development_model),
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data = outer_train
)

selected_severity_model_2023_2025 <- glm(
  formula(selected_severity_development_model),
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  weights = ClaimNb,
  data = outer_train %>% filter(ClaimNb > 0)
)

selected_frequency_prediction_2026 <- predict(
  selected_frequency_model_2023_2025,
  newdata = outer_validation,
  type = "response"
)

selected_severity_prediction_positive_2026 <- predict(
  selected_severity_model_2023_2025,
  newdata = outer_validation %>% filter(ClaimNb > 0),
  type = "response"
)

selected_severity_prediction_all_2026 <- predict(
  selected_severity_model_2023_2025,
  newdata = outer_validation,
  type = "response"
)

outer_severity_actual <- outer_validation %>% filter(ClaimNb > 0)

selected_frequency_validation_2026 <- tibble(
  ActualClaims = sum(outer_validation$ClaimNb),
  PredictedClaims = sum(selected_frequency_prediction_2026),
  ActualToExpected = ActualClaims / PredictedClaims,
  MAE = mean(abs(
    outer_validation$ClaimNb - selected_frequency_prediction_2026
  )),
  RMSE = sqrt(mean(
    (outer_validation$ClaimNb - selected_frequency_prediction_2026)^2
  )),
  PoissonDeviance = poisson_deviance_total(
    outer_validation$ClaimNb,
    selected_frequency_prediction_2026
  )
)

selected_severity_validation_2026 <- tibble(
  ActualSeverity = weighted.mean(
    outer_severity_actual$AvgSeverity,
    outer_severity_actual$ClaimNb
  ),
  PredictedSeverity = weighted.mean(
    selected_severity_prediction_positive_2026,
    outer_severity_actual$ClaimNb
  ),
  ActualToExpected = ActualSeverity / PredictedSeverity,
  WeightedMAE = weighted.mean(
    abs(
      outer_severity_actual$AvgSeverity -
        selected_severity_prediction_positive_2026
    ),
    outer_severity_actual$ClaimNb
  ),
  WeightedRMSE = sqrt(weighted.mean(
    (
      outer_severity_actual$AvgSeverity -
        selected_severity_prediction_positive_2026
    )^2,
    outer_severity_actual$ClaimNb
  )),
  MeanGammaDeviance = gamma_deviance_mean(
    outer_severity_actual$AvgSeverity,
    selected_severity_prediction_positive_2026,
    outer_severity_actual$ClaimNb
  )
)

selected_combined_validation_2026 <- outer_validation %>%
  mutate(
    PredictedFrequency = selected_frequency_prediction_2026,
    PredictedSeverity = selected_severity_prediction_all_2026,
    PredictedCost = PredictedFrequency * PredictedSeverity
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    ActualTotal = sum(ClaimAmount),
    PredictedTotal = sum(PredictedCost),
    ActualToExpected = ActualTotal / PredictedTotal,
    MAE = mean(abs(ClaimAmount - PredictedCost)),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((ClaimAmount - PredictedCost)^2))
  )

knitr::kable(
  selected_frequency_validation_2026,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Selected frequency model validation on 2026"
)

knitr::kable(
  selected_severity_validation_2026,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Selected severity model validation on 2026"
)

knitr::kable(
  selected_combined_validation_2026,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Selected frequency-severity validation on 2026"
)
```
